WITH eligible_monthly_rows AS (SELECT (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r."ProviderName") AS "CompanyId", r."PeriodStart" AS "PeriodStart", r."PeriodEnd" AS "PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode" AS "ProductCode", li."Title" AS "ProductTitle", li."SalesQuantity" AS "Value", li."Unit" AS "SourceUnit", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r."ProviderName"), r."PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode") AS "SamePeriodCandidateCount", r."ProviderName" AS "ProviderName", r."ReportType" AS "ReportType", r."OutputType" AS "OutputType", r."RevisionStatus" AS "RevisionStatus", r."Id" AS "ReportIdentity", r."ExternalReportId" AS "ExternalReportId", li."SourceRowFingerprint" AS "SourceRowFingerprint", li."SourceMultiplicity" AS "SourceMultiplicity" FROM "public"."MonthlyReportLineItems" li JOIN "public"."MonthlyReports" r ON li."MonthlyReportId" = r."Id" WHERE (r."ProviderName", r."ExternalCompanyId") IN (SELECT mc."ProviderName", mc."ExternalCompanyId" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."Id" = @company_id) AND r."ProviderName" = @provider_name AND r."ReportType" = @report_type AND r."OutputType" = @output_type AND r."IsAccepted" = @is_accepted AND r."RevisionStatus" = @revision_status AND li."ProductCode" = @product_code AND r."PeriodStart" >= @period_start AND r."PeriodEnd" <= @period_end),
projected_monthly_rows AS (SELECT * FROM eligible_monthly_rows)
SELECT *, "ReportIdentity" AS "ReportId" FROM projected_monthly_rows ORDER BY "CompanyId", "PeriodEnd" ASC, "ProductCode", "SourceMultiplicity" LIMIT @row_limit OFFSET @row_offset
